transcript.statement: The requirements I propose focus on minimizing energy consumption and promoting sustainability in the RollCall system. GRN-01 ensures efficient algorithms reduce energy use during data processing. GRN-02 emphasizes the use of energy-efficient cloud storage. GRN-03 allows for low-energy communication protocols for real-time updates. GRN-04 promotes resource-efficient report generation. GRN-05 raises awareness of carbon footprints, and GRN-06 aligns data retention with sustainable practices. GRN-07 optimizes the user interface for low-power devices. These requirements are essential for reducing the environmental impact of the system.

transcript.statement: The Trustworthiness requirements are crucial for ensuring the security and privacy of student attendance data. TRU-01 mandates encryption to protect data at rest and in transit, while TRU-02 implements role-based access control to restrict data access based on user roles, enhancing security. TRU-03 ensures auditability by maintaining logs of all access and modifications, and TRU-04 guarantees that students can only view their records after authentication, protecting their privacy. TRU-05 verifies data integrity, and TRU-06 provides a mechanism for reporting unauthorized access. TRU-07 enforces session timeouts to prevent unauthorized access during inactivity. These requirements collectively safeguard sensitive information and maintain trust in the system.

transcript.statement: The Efficiency requirements are vital for ensuring the RollCall system performs optimally under various conditions. EFF-03 focuses on quick report generation, enhancing usability for administrators. EFF-04 aligns with historical data retention while optimizing storage. EFF-05 ensures students can access their records swiftly, improving user experience. EFF-06 promotes resource optimization through load balancing, and EFF-07 ensures a responsive user interface. Together, these requirements enhance the system's performance efficiency.

transcript.statement: The Responsibility requirements are essential for ensuring ethical compliance and accountability in the RollCall system. RES-01 mandates adherence to data protection regulations like GDPR, safeguarding student privacy. RES-02 promotes transparency by logging attendance changes, fostering trust. RES-03 allows students to dispute records, ensuring fairness. RES-04 protects student identities in reports, aligning with ethical standards. RES-05 ensures timely notifications about attendance status, enhancing communication. RES-06 reinforces access control for authorized personnel, maintaining data integrity. RES-07 ensures compliance with educational regulations regarding data retention. Together, these requirements uphold ethical standards and social responsibility in handling sensitive data.

transcript.statement: The Safety requirements are critical for ensuring the security and reliability of the RollCall system. SAF-01 ensures secure authentication to prevent unauthorized access, while SAF-02 guarantees real-time data synchronization for accurate attendance records. SAF-03 implements automated alerts for discrepancies, enhancing data accuracy. SAF-04 mandates storing historical data for five years, supporting long-term analysis. SAF-05 provides a logging mechanism for accountability, and SAF-06 allows manual overrides during failures, ensuring fault tolerance. SAF-07 emphasizes regular security audits to identify vulnerabilities, maintaining system integrity. Together, these requirements create a robust safety framework.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication and encryption of user data to prevent unauthorized access.
The system shall implement energy-efficient algorithms for real-time data synchronization and processing.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years to comply with regulations.
The system shall provide automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting to ensure data accuracy.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records after successful authentication.
The system shall provide a logging mechanism for all attendance modifications to support accountability.
The system shall notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict attendance data access to authorized personnel only.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days.
The system shall provide a user interface that responds to user interactions within 1 second.
